title: [CAM] Rapid whip-pan left -> [STATE IN] Sleds sliding parallel at high speed ->…
content: [CAM] Rapid whip-pan left -> [STATE IN] Sleds sliding parallel at high speed -> [ACT] Arthur's neon disc catches a hidden sand lip, pitching him sideways -> [STATE OUT] Arthur begins to tip off-balance into the sand -> [AUDIO] Sudden thud, loud rustle of sliding fabric

es.content:
---
[CAM] Rápido whip-pan hacia la izquierda -> [STATE IN] Trineos deslizándose en paralelo a gran velocidad -> [ACT] El disco de neón de Arthur engancha un borde oculto de arena, haciéndolo volcarse de lado -> [STATE OUT] Arthur empieza a perder el equilibrio y a caer sobre la arena -> [AUDIO] Golpe repentino, fuerte crujido de la tela al deslizarse
---

fr.content:
---
[CAM] Whip-pan rapide vers la gauche -> [STATE IN] Des luges glissent parallèlement à grande vitesse -> [ACT] Le disque néon d’Arthur accroche une lèvre de sable cachée, le faisant basculer sur le côté -> [STATE OUT] Arthur commence à perdre l’équilibre et à basculer dans le sable -> [AUDIO] Bruit sourd soudain, fort froissement du tissu qui glisse
---

ja.content:
---
[CAM] 左へ素早い whip-pan -> [STATE IN] ソリが高速で平行に滑走 -> [ACT] アーサーのネオンディスクが隠れた砂の縁に引っかかり、彼を横向きに投げ出す -> [STATE OUT] アーサーはバランスを崩して砂の中へ倒れ込み始める -> [AUDIO] 突然のドスンという音、滑る布の大きな擦れ音
---

ko.content:
---
[CAM] 빠른 휩팬 왼쪽 -> [STATE IN] 썰매들이 고속으로 평행하게 미끄러진다 -> [ACT] 아서의 네온 디스크가 숨겨진 모래 턱에 걸려 그를 옆으로 내던진다 -> [STATE OUT] 아서가 균형을 잃고 모래 속으로 기울기 시작한다 -> [AUDIO] 갑작스러운 쿵 하는 소리, 미끄러지는 천의 거친 바스락거림
---

pt.content: [CAM] whip-pan rápido para a esquerda -> [STATE IN] trenós deslizando em paralelo em alta velocidade -> [ACT] o disco neon de Arthur encontra um lábio de areia oculto, lançando-o de lado -> [STATE OUT] Arthur começa a perder o equilíbrio e a tombar na areia -> [AUDIO] baque súbito, forte ruído de tecido deslizando

zh.content:
---
[CAM] 快速甩镜左移 -> [STATE IN] 雪橇以高速平行滑行 -> [ACT] Arthur 的霓虹圆盘碰到一处隐藏的沙脊边缘，将他猛地掀向一侧 -> [STATE OUT] Arthur 开始失去平衡，向沙地里倾斜 -> [AUDIO] 突然的闷响，滑动织物发出的响亮沙沙声
---
